Senior Backend Engineer – Northwind Labs (fictional)

About the role
Northwind Labs is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build the services behind our logistics platform.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and maintain scalable RESTful APIs in Node.js.
- Own background job processing and queue-based workflows.
- Improve database performance through indexing and query optimization.
- Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
- Collaborate with product and frontend teams in an Agile environment.

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional software development experience.
- Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
- Hands-on experience with MongoDB and Redis.
- Experience with Docker and AWS.
- Experience with React.js for internal tools.

Nice to have
- NestJS
- AWS Lambda
- Kubernetes
- GraphQL

What we offer: flexible hours, learning budget, health insurance.
